title: Alternative to Hiring a Marketing Manager for a Small Business
meta_title: Alternative to Hiring a Marketing Manager (UK Guide)
meta_description: Alternatives to hiring a marketing manager: freelancers, fractional CMOs, agencies or a £389/mo marketing team subscription. UK costs compared.
keywords: alternative to hiring a marketing manager

faq.q: What is the alternative to hiring a marketing manager?
faq.a: Outsource to a freelancer, a fractional marketing lead, an agency, or a marketing subscription such as ContentFellow's Growth Fellow at £389 a month.

faq.q: How much does a marketing manager cost in the UK?
faq.a: Around £35,000–£50,000 a year in salary, plus employer NI, pension and equipment.

faq.q: Is outsourcing marketing cheaper than hiring?
faq.a: Usually yes for small businesses. A subscription costs a fraction of a salary and covers several skills.

faq.q: Can I outsource marketing with no long contract?
faq.a: Yes. ContentFellow plans are monthly with no long contract.
